fighter.title: How to use Strikers Match
fighter.intro: Your account keeps your fighter profile ready, lets you apply to events, confirm payments, and respond to fight proposals.

steps.title: Complete your profile
steps.body: Add weight, discipline, record, gym, availability, and medical details when required.

steps.title: Find events
steps.body: Review published events and apply only to the ones that match your discipline, weight, and availability.

steps.title: Confirm your registration
steps.body: Once the promoter confirms your payment, you enter that event's matchmaking pool.

steps.title: Respond to proposals
steps.body: Each proposal requires both fighters to respond before it can become a bout.

spectator.title: Follow athletes
spectator.intro: Your account lets you follow fighters, review their record, and track progress from your own dashboard.

steps.title: Find athletes
steps.body: Explore the athlete directory and open the profiles you want to follow.

steps.title: Follow fighters
steps.body: On each athlete profile, use Follow athlete to add them to your dashboard.

steps.title: Review progress
steps.body: Your dashboard shows record, availability, and quick access to the profiles you follow.

promoter.title: Event workflow
promoter.intro: Your account controls the full workflow: event, registrations, matchmaking, bouts, printing, and event-day operations.

steps.title: Create or publish an event
steps.body: Set the city, date, disciplines, and fight-card needs.

steps.title: Review applications and payments
steps.body: Accept fighters, confirm external payments, and prepare the registration pool.

steps.title: Use matchmaking
steps.body: Suggestions only allow fighters compatible by discipline, weight, age, level, and rules.

steps.title: Generate bouts and sheets
steps.body: Approve permanent bouts, order mats, and use print or live mode on event day.

manager.title: Fighter and event management
manager.intro: Your account lets you manage a roster, add manual fighters, create your own events, and operate those event workflows.

steps.title: Build your roster
steps.body: Add existing fighters or register manual fighters under your account.

steps.title: Create your own events
steps.body: Managers can create events and manage their registration and matchmaking workflow.

steps.title: Send requests
steps.body: You can contact fighters for opportunities and replacements when the event workflow requires it.

steps.title: Operate events assigned to your account
steps.body: For events you create, you have access to settings, matchmaking, bouts, print, and live mode.

sponsor.title: Sponsorships and contacts
sponsor.intro: Your account helps you find fighters, promoters, and services connected to combat sports events.

steps.title: Find fighters
steps.body: Filter profiles by city, availability, discipline, and public details.

steps.title: Review promoters and events
steps.body: Identify active events and organizers with a public presence.

steps.title: Contact relevant profiles
steps.body: Protected contact details require a session and permissions based on the contact type.

admin.title: Platform control
admin.intro: Your account has operational visibility across users, events, fighters, proposals, bouts, and platform status.

steps.title: Review the dashboard
steps.body: Monitor users, fighters, events, matches, and bouts from the main panel.

steps.title: Audit matches and bouts
steps.body: The matches/bouts page shows proposals and permanent event records.

steps.title: Manage profiles
steps.body: Review fighters, managers, promoters, sponsors, and professionals from the admin sections.

vendor.title: Service profile
vendor.intro: Your account lets you appear in the services directory and receive contacts from signed-in users.

steps.title: Complete your public profile
steps.body: Add city, experience, availability, photo, and a clear service description.

steps.title: Appear in the Directory
steps.body: Your profile can be found by promoters, managers, sponsors, and other users.

steps.title: Keep details updated
steps.body: Protected contacts depend on your information being accurate and available.

default.title: How the platform works
default.intro: The platform connects profiles, events, requests, registrations, matchmaking, and event-day operations.

steps.title: Explore events
steps.body: Events are the center of registrations, fights, and results.

steps.title: Complete your profile
steps.body: Each account type has different actions depending on its role.

steps.title: Use the correct dashboard
steps.body: The user menu takes you to the dashboard that matches your profile.
